title: An infrastructure change opened access to customer exports

incident.title: An infrastructure change opened access to customer exports
incident.how: PR #214 replaced scoped S3 permissions with a wildcard. Terraform run-881 applied the policy; the workload-to-customer-data edge appeared two minutes later.
incident.blast: 14 reachable assets in the example inventory, including customer-data, export-history and orders backup objects.
incident.prevention: Revert to scoped GetObject permissions, block wildcard IAM actions in CI and compare the resulting access graph before deployment.
incident.source: Terraform plan + CloudTrail PutRolePolicy + graph snapshots
